narrative: The tech world is currently focused on significant developments, including Google's new Gemini 4 Hydrogen AI model and the dramatic resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang amidst a national security-related scandal. Concurrently, Microsoft is grappling with a widespread service outage, underscoring ongoing challenges in cloud infrastructure. These events highlight rapid advancements in AI alongside critical concerns regarding cybersecurity, corporate ethics, and system reliability.

highlights.title: Global Microsoft Outage
highlights.whyItMatters: A widespread Microsoft service degradation impacts users globally, highlighting the critical reliance on cloud infrastructure and the far-reaching effects of service disruptions.

highlights.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amidst Scandal
highlights.whyItMatters: The unexpected departure of Nvidia's CEO amidst scandal creates leadership uncertainty and raises national security and market stability concerns within the critical AI chip sector.

highlights.title: Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
highlights.whyItMatters: This significant AI model advancement promises more intuitive and effective search experiences by enhancing understanding of complex queries.

highlights.title: Rust 1.100
highlights.whyItMatters: The Rust programming language reaches a significant milestone, reflecting its growing maturity and importance for secure and performant software development.

highlights.title: Cyberattack on Fireworks AI allowed hackers to access Notion customers’ chat transcripts
highlights.whyItMatters: This second data breach for Fireworks AI within months underscores critical security vulnerabilities in third-party AI services and their potential impact on sensitive customer data.

highlights.title: Dwarf planet candidate appears which takes roughly 280 years to orbit our sun
highlights.whyItMatters: Astronomers have found a new dwarf planet candidate beyond Pluto, expanding our understanding of the solar system's distant reaches.

highlights.title: Build once, run on any agent: A practical guide to agent skills
highlights.whyItMatters: GitHub's guide to agentic engineering empowers developers to create versatile AI agents, accelerating software development and improving efficiency across diverse platforms.
